verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an observability platform, but the evidence pack never documents bulk actions across many items, such as bulk-editing alerts, rules, cases or agents. Fleet's central agent management (elastic-docs-17) is an adjacent feature, not a documented bulk-operation capability. Searching or querying many logs at once is read access, not a bulk action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
